editorial:
Imagine waking up and finding out a jet engine just crashed into your bedroom, but you somehow survived because a giant, creepy rabbit told you to go outside. That is exactly how your journey starts with Donnie. You will meet a lonely teen who feels like he does not fit in with the other kids at school. The whole movie has a strange, moody feeling that makes you feel like something is just slightly off. It is not a typical scary movie, but it keeps you on edge as you watch Donnie follow these weird instructions that lead him to burn down a house and mess with his town.

Jake Gyllenhaal does a great job making you care about a kid who is clearly struggling. The plot is a bit of a puzzle, so you might feel lost at first, but that is part of the fun. If you like stories that make you think and question what is real, you will love this. To get the best experience, you should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the dark details. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your shelf is a smart move for those repeat viewings.
endingExplained: Donnie discovers he is part of a glitch in time. To save everyone he loves, he has to make sure the jet engine hits his house instead of missing it. He chooses to stay in his room and let the plane crash on him. This resets the timeline, meaning he dies, but the other characters live on. They feel a strange sadness they cannot explain, knowing they lost someone important even though the world changed.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves puzzles and strange stories.
